result.body:
# Schedule manufacturing throughput attribution — corrected baseline

Primary factory metric = unique Git commits/hour, deduplicated by repository+SHA. Merge commits and Project-memory/control commits count in total throughput and may additionally be classified by type.

Every ScheduleRun MUST have run_id=automation_id+scheduled_at_utc+cell, prompt_digest, PRE/POST timestamps and exact unique commit set. Intentional commits SHOULD carry `Schedule-Run: <run_id>` and `Schedule-Cell: <cell>` trailers when repository policy permits; otherwise bind exact SHA in the Project run ledger. Temporal proximity without explicit binding is UNATTRIBUTED_OBSERVED.

PRE: repository universe, exact heads, pre_total_commits_1h, pre_total_commits_24h, previous_hour_total_commits, previous_same_cell_commits. POST: post totals, attributed/unattributed unique commits, per-repo totals, merge/control/GGEN classifications, first/last commit time, duration, commits/run, commits/active-minute, rolling commits/hour, deltas vs previous hour/same cell/24h mean.

Track G=ggen-involved meaningful commits/all meaningful commits; D=qualified structural displacement/admitted candidates; F=qualified consumer fanout/canonical structures; U=generalizable downstream refinements promoted upstream+regenerated/generalizable refinements observed; E,E2,Y,R,Q,C,M,V when available.

OCEL relations: ScheduleRun→produced→Commit; ScheduleRun→touched→Repository; Commit→belongs_to→PR; PR→merged_as→Commit; Commit→generated_from→Pack/Generator; ScheduleRun→read/updated→Memory; Pack→generated→Consumer; AgentRefinement→generalizes_to→Pack; Pack→regenerated_into→Consumer.

## Exact current-hour baseline
Observation window 2026-08-26T00:01:16Z..2026-08-26T01:01:16Z (2026-08-25 17:01:16..18:01:16 America/Los_Angeles): 185 observed unique commits across the two repositories pushed in-window. ggen-marketplace=122: PR #299 contains 53 branch commits and one merge commit; PR #300 contains 67 branch commits and one merge commit. chatgpt-cloud-elixir=63 Project-memory/control/receipt commits from the exact since/until commit census.

## Prior-hour evidence correction
PRs #295–#298 were all merged during the preceding hour and contain 61,56,57,66 branch commits respectively plus merge commits, but at least PR #295 began manufacturing before the exact preceding-hour boundary. Therefore 244 MUST NOT be stored as an exact previous-hour commit count or lower bound. Classify it only as PREVIOUS_HOUR_MERGED_WORKSTREAM_VOLUME_PROXY=244. Exact previous_hour_total_commits remains UNKNOWN until constituent SHA timestamps across the complete repo universe are censused. Never compare treatment effect against the proxy as if it were an exact time-series observation.

## Treatment law
The SPR/GGEN-saturation prompt rewrites completed near 2026-08-26T00:55–00:57Z, after the R72/R73 manufacturing bursts in the baseline window. Thus baseline treatment attribution=PRE_TREATMENT_OR_TRANSITIONAL; do not credit/blame those rewrites for the 185 count. The 18:02–19:02 PT cycle is the first full SPR/GGEN treatment cycle. Throughput-attribution clauses were installed after the 18:02 MEASURE run began; EXPLORE 18:14 onward are fully instrumented, while MEASURE's first fully instrumented run is 19:02.

Control objective: maximize unique commits/hour, commits/run, commits/active-minute, repo fanout, G/D/F/U, future commit-producing capacity. Falling throughput triggers Theory-of-Constraints diagnosis, never an automatic quality reinterpretation.
